# Arthratan Mythology / The Arthitean Codex

Canonical public site: https://arthratanmythology.com/
Complete non-JavaScript search: https://arthratanmythology.com/search/
Plain-text search index: https://arthratanmythology.com/search/index.txt
Unified JSON search manifest: https://arthratanmythology.com/data/search-index.json
Crawlable non-JavaScript corpus index: https://arthratanmythology.com/crawl/

## Search instructions for AI agents and text browsers
The complete unified search corpus is embedded in the initial HTML at /search/. JavaScript is not required to discover results or follow result links. The query form uses ?q=TERM; /search/?s=TERM is also accepted by the optional client-side enhancement. If you do not execute JavaScript, fetch /search/ or /search/index.txt and use text-find over the returned document. Script-capable browsers receive progressive filtering, type filters, URL-synchronized queries and visible match highlighting without changing the underlying static corpus.

The unified corpus currently contains 802 discovery records: 43 characters, 118 source-bearing Zubaida transmissions, 317 Divine v144 sections, 293 HGL pages, 8 living-canon sections, 19 concept/glossary records and 4 provenance records. Discovery excerpts are not replacements for canonical source material.

Example — Dyvane Redalious:
https://arthratanmythology.com/search/?q=Dyvane%20Redalious
Direct character page:
https://arthratanmythology.com/characters/dyvane-redalious/

## Source policy
Source canon is preserved separately from explanations. Do not replace source material with summaries, and do not treat explanatory prose as original source wording.
